fact: Taazour's delegate general says it has a digital database of over 1.5 million citizens and an advanced digital platform through which it provides social assistance to beneficiaries.

A World Bank SASPP policy note says Mauritania's Tekavoul national safety-net programme runs on its own information system (the Tekavoul information system), whose limited interoperability with the Social Registry delayed the beneficiary list renewal, while the programme made quarterly cash transfers to nearly 138,000 households in June 2026.
